messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — our Q1 sim shows embedding+rankspeeds hitting ~2.3x baseline during the Dec->Feb promo window. We should hedge capacity for separate realtime pool + larger nightly batch window.
liam: Can you drop the numbers? I need GPU-hour delta for the cost model.
zara: also note eu-west-1 procurement limits + network egress caps in us-west, could constrain cross-region spill.
maya: TL;DR from sim: peak_gpu_hours ~3,450 over the month, 95th p95 latency target 150ms for realtime, median qps up 1.6x. Nightly batch jobs currently consume ~8k qph and can be shifted.
liam: ok rough cost math — if we prewarm 8 A100-style nodes for realtime: 8 nodes * 24h * 30d * ~$2.2k/node-month ~= $17.6k/month (ballpark). Batch on spot saves ~40-60% if evictions are handled.
raj: Proposal: 1) Reserve minimal dedicated realtime baseline: prewarm 8, autoscale to 32 for bursts. 2) Run batch on a spot pool with eviction-safe queue. 3) Spill non-latency-critical realtime to us-central once eu-west saturates. 4) Move heavy retrains/offline reranks into a tight 02:00-05:00 window.
maya: +1. Also we should enforce per-route SLO tiers so critical rerank stays in dedicated pool. Non-critical rerank -> spill/spot.
infra-bot: SimResults: peak_gpu_hours=3450; reserve_realtime=8; batch_spot_hours=1800; est_monthly_cost_delta=$19,200; util_95pct=78%
zara: network tradeoffs: cross-region adds ~3ms median RTT and ~0.08 USD/GB egress. For rerank payloads (~0.5KB per request) egress costs are tolerable for spill as long as we cap at ~2TB/day.
raj: Config sketch for scheduler:```
scheduler:
  realtime_pool:
    min: 8
    max: 32
    prewarm: 8
  batch_pool:
    min: 0
    max: 50
    spot: true
    window: "02:00-05:00"
  spill_policy:
    prefer_region: us-central
    max_egress_gb: 2000/day
```
liam: I'll add a quick cost sensitivity sheet and run a 24h load sim next Tue to validate autoscale thresholds. :rocket:
maya: Thanks — can we all sync Wed 11 for cutover/ops playbook? I'll draft runbook. @sre-oncall FYI.
sre-oncall: ACK — will set alerts: p95 latency >150ms, sustained gpu util >85% for 10m, and spike in egress >1.5TB/day.
liam: Also suggestion: add a short-lived 'burst' reserved slot (billing-coded) we can buy for the 2-week promo and release after. Will check procurement lead times.
maya: Perfect. I'll circulate the draft RFC and the sim artifacts after lunch.
